biomarkers.name: WHO 2022 / ICC lineage-assignment criteria
biomarkers.clinical_use: Lineage assignment for MPAL requires strict criteria. Myeloid: MPO positive (by flow cytometry, IHC, or cytochemistry) or monocytic differentiation. Monocytic lineage is assigned by at least 2 of the following: nonspecific esterase, CD11c, CD14, CD64, lysozyme. T-lineage: strong cytoplasmic CD3 or surface CD3. B-lineage: strong CD19 with at least 1 strongly expressed B-marker (CD79a, cytoplasmic CD22, or CD10), or weak CD19 with at least 2 strongly expressed B-markers.

biomarkers.name: BCR-ABL1 t(9;22) (MPAL with BCR::ABL1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines a recurrent genetic subtype of MPAL, usually B/myeloid; tyrosine kinase inhibitor should be incorporated into therapy.

biomarkers.name: KMT2A (MLL) rearrangements
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines a recurrent genetic subtype of MPAL; generally associated with adverse risk. Menin inhibitors are emerging in KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemias.

biomarkers.name: ZNF384 rearrangements
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent fusion class described particularly in B/myeloid MPAL; biologically distinct but not a WHO 2022 defining subtype.

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Blast morphology with mixed lineage marker expression on flow cytometry — WHO 2022 criteria for lineage assignment
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; generally considered high-risk acute leukemia

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow infiltration by blasts with mixed lineage markers

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Presumed primitive haematopoietic progenitor with multilineage differentiation potential
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — haematopoietic (uncommitted or incompletely committed between lymphoid and myeloid lineages)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mixed lineage marker expression by WHO 2022 criteria: B/myeloid MPAL (most common — B lineage markers + myeloid markers), T/myeloid MPAL (T lineage + myeloid), B/T MPAL (very rare), trilineage MPAL
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Marked lineage ambiguity/plasticity is characteristic. Recurrent molecular subgroups include BCR::ABL1, KMT2A rearrangements, and ZNF384 rearrangements, particularly in B/myeloid cases.
